newsitem.title: USA: Plains fed cattle market active at $72 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: Plains fed cattle market active at $72 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday traded briskly at $72.00 per cwt, steady with last week's top price paid in central and southern Plains feedlots, feedlot sources said.
About 14,000 head were reported sold in Kansas and about 5,000 in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area, USDA and private sources said.
However, some other cattle owners were still holding out for $73.00 to $74.00, they said.
Prices were underpinned by tight supplies of market-ready cattle and strong beef demand, cattle feeders said.
